independentReview.note: The one major, reported by six reviewers, was a CHANGELOG sentence promising that a reused summary always matches the latest games, which ADR 0072's G1-G3 rule out; it now says reuse follows the same per-account revision checks as the other covered charts. The minors and nits made the real-Mongo suite run the production composition, pinned concurrent filtered and unfiltered isolation, race-only flag-off sharing and the race variant's retirement, and corrected the checkpoint's HEAD, caller, admission-frequency, recompute-cost and remaining-work wording.
